documentation.title: Documented Flags
documentation.standard:
Every flag a command reads must be in its synopsis: WP-CLI hides undocumented flags from "wp help" and rejects them as unknown once a synopsis exists. WP_CLI::confirm( $msg, $assoc_args ) reads --yes. Documented flags the handler never reads are reported too, unless the assoc args are passed on to other code. Global parameters (--url, --path, ...) and a generic [--<field>=<value>] entry are accepted.
Requirement: G1 (advisory, warning; not in CLIStandardsMust). Error codes: UndocumentedFlag, UnusedFlag. Properties: ignoreMethods (method names that are never commands), ignoreClasses (classes that are never command classes).
